title_en: Get up, Donka, get up, little bird
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Dialogue between mother and Donka, then the suitor's oath. 'Се колни' is translated as 'swore' (my reading).

lines.en: - Get up, Donka, get up, little bird, early,

lines.cyr: свршеникот ќе ти дојде, еј Донке бре,

lines.en: your betrothed will come, hey Donka,

lines.cyr: - Ако дојде, нека дојде, нејќам го,

lines.en: - If he comes, let him come, I don't want him,
